title: Sign in with ChatGPT
summary: You can now sign in to Conductor with your ChatGPT account and run Codex on your ChatGPT plan.
body_markdown:
September 29, 2026


# Sign in with ChatGPT


We're excited to be partnering with OpenAI on Sign in with ChatGPT.


You can now bring your ChatGPT plan to Conductor in a few clicks. Go to **Settings → Agents → Codex** and click **Continue with ChatGPT** to start using your Codex plan in Conductor.


For new users: when you create an account, choose "Continue with ChatGPT" to bring your ChatGPT identity and plan to Conductor. Codex will then use your plan with no API key or` codex login` . If you've already set up Codex another way, Conductor keeps your setup.


[Download Conductor](https://www.conductor.build/) and give it a try.
